name: natus-mvp
description: Natus MVP - static demo of the user product. No backend, no database.

scripts.sync:shared: rm -rf supabase/functions/_shared/lib supabase/functions/_shared/data && mkdir -p supabase/functions/_shared/lib/schemas supabase/functions/_shared/data && find src/lib -name '*.ts' ! -name '*.test.ts' -exec sh -c 'cp "$1" "supabase/functions/_shared/${1#src/}"' _ {} \; && cp data/*.json supabase/functions/_shared/data/
